response.sql: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS value FROM event_ratios) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / NULLIF(a.value, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS e CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
